stale hand cannot close an earlier opening
focus loss blocks input with a precise reason
the actual consultation dialog blocks both opening and closure
blur clears a lost mouse release and a subsequent hand cut works
resize cancels the pending cut and fresh input recovers
rigid compound wrist rotation cannot cut through the production scene
near-perspective fixed aperture rotating in yaw never cuts
natural bent-finger closure cuts geometry once and held close cannot repeat
loss of the active projected palm metric cannot manufacture a cut
retracted index and fist cannot trigger a pinch in the actual scene
named side and back views preserve cuts and expose real cuttable hair
switching view consumes an earlier opening and held pinch cannot cut after switch
mouse cutting is suspended during view changes and needs a fresh press
explicit stop freezes the final trial with its cause
